title: desmodium seleri
intro: Desmodium seleri, commonly known as Serilena or Serileno, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to Central America and Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Desmodium seleri are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, lower fever, and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium seleri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
